about: Gatineau is in western Québec, on the north shore of the Ottawa River across from Ottawa. It is Québec’s fourth-largest city and part of the National Capital Region. The city was formed by merging Hull, Gatineau, Aylmer, Buckingham, and Masson-Angers. About 290,000 people live in Gatineau.
seoSummary: Québec city across the Ottawa River from the capital, home to the Museum of History.
